sentences.text: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 08.11.2023 CRL.M.A. 30623/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is accordingly disposed of.

3. The present application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR no.
361/2023, under Sections 498A/406/354/354A/506/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Welcome.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that notice under Section 41A of the Cr.P.C. has not been served upon him.
5. Per contra learned APP for the State, on instructions of the Investigating Officer, submits that the latter had gone to the residence of the This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: Issue notice.
7. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to learned counsel for the applicant.
8. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant also accepts notice.
9. Re-notify on 31.01.2024.

10. In the meantime, on the applicant being served a notice under Section 41A of the Cr.P.C, he shall join the investigation as and when directed by the Investigating Officer and no coercive steps shall be taken against the applicant till the next date of hearing.
11.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court forthwith.
AMIT SHARMA, J NOVEMBER 8, 2023/bsr
